reason: The plugin’s user-facing purpose is a UI entrypoint enhancement: it adds a sidebar control in DSH and routes users to chat.deepseek.com, preferring a desktop-child-window flow when the local desktop bridge is available and otherwise using webview navigation. This is a navigation/interaction plugin with a minor local-bridge call and a toggle setting, so it is best classified under navigation-panels with moderate caution around network and local bridge use.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 侧边栏新增“网页对话”入口，默认可点击打开 chat.deepseek.com，在支持 dsh-desktop 的环境下优先以独立子窗口打开聊天，否则在当前页面内跳转。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a "Web Chat" entry in the DSH sidebar to open chat.deepseek.com, opening it in a dedicated desktop child window when the dsh-desktop bridge is available, and otherwise navigating in the current webview.

capabilities: Adds a sidebar entry in the DSH web UI
Opens the DeepSeek web chat URL via browser navigation
Invokes a local desktop bridge endpoint when present to open a dedicated chat window
Falls back to in-webview behavior if the bridge is unavailable
Registers a user setting to show/hide the entry

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a "网页对话" button under New Session in the sidebar to open chat.deepseek.com.
README describes fallback behavior: use window.__DSH_DESKTOP_API__/window/chat in dsh-desktop, otherwise navigate in the current webview.
package.json exposes web client entry and DSH bundle patch for integration into the web plugin roster.
